name: describe_scene
description: Describe an existing image or current visual scene for a visually impaired user.

name: read_text
description: Read visible text from an existing image or captured view.

name: identify_object
description: Find a named object in the visual context and describe its relative position.

name: check_sensor_context
description: Get a combined local sensor summary for light, near distance, temperature, humidity, pressure, and motion.

name: measure_brightness
description: Measure ambient light and classify whether the environment is dark, dim, normal, bright, or too bright.

name: detect_near_obstacle
description: Check whether there is a very near obstacle in front of the user using short-range distance data.

name: get_environment_status
description: Read local temperature, humidity, pressure, and comfort status. This is not official weather.

name: detect_motion_state
description: Check whether the device is stable, tilted, shaking, moving, or possibly dropped.

name: capture_image
description: Capture a fresh camera image when current visual evidence is needed.

name: set_reminder
description: Set a reminder for the user.

name: search_contact
description: Search the user's contacts before making a phone call. Never invent phone numbers.

name: cancel_action
description: Cancel an active navigation, reminder, speech, capture, or current action.

name: get_date
description: Get the current date from the device.

name: get_time
description: Get the current time from the device.

name: make_call
description: Start a phone call only after contact search and user confirmation.
